name: Flagged weak in a skill the track actually names
description: First persona to exercise weak-skill notes (step 5, wired 2026-10-20 after the quiz's own skills-rating stage turned out to be collected and never read by the recommender). Flags 'programming_language_concepts' as weak (a real skill name from software_engineering.yaml's own skills_weighted) and 'software_design' as known-strong (weak: false) -- only the first should produce a note, surfacing that skill's real F53 evidence verbatim. Deliberately does NOT assert a specific foundation-first module tied to this skill: the schema has no skill-to-module mapping to test against, a real, documented scoping limit (see engine.py's _weak_skill_notes docstring), not something this persona should pretend to verify.
